nom: Amazon Essentials Exfoliating Apricot Face Scrub

avis.texte: I want to say that I have mixed feelings about putting this on my face but that would be a total understatement. To give you a little insight, I’ve been using the Kylie Skin walnut face scrub since May of last year. I used the walnut face scrub once a day, 3-4 times a week and I’m still in love with it. However, I was looking for a more budget-friendly alternative and I gave this one a try. What I love is, it does everything my other walnut face scrub did but it doesn’t make my skin feel stripped or dry (the Kylie skin did a little bit). It checked all my boxes in regard to why I bought the product! HOWEVER—upon my first time using it, I squeezed a bit of the scrub onto my hand and I was hit with this overwhelming scent of straight vomit. I couldn’t even believe it, I literally had to keep smelling it and it definitely smelled like something I’ve thrown up before. I did debate whether or not I should even put it on my face but, for whatever reason, I was feeling optimistic and lathered it into my pores and I LOVED it. It does NOT leave that smell lingering on my face. That would be the definite dealbreaker for me. But as you rub it in the smell goes away. I also use a multitude of other products after that one, so any excess gets wiped away. I’m telling myself that naturally made products don’t typically have scents because those scents are often artificially created using harsh chemicals that can be harmful to your skin. So maybe the use of more earthy, organic ingredients i

this scrub has changed over the years since i have been using it and i feel it it has gotten better every time. I have a subscription because i refuse to use anything else. I love how much exfoliant is inside and how smooth and clear it makes my face. the scent is not all amazing but also not bad at all. this has changed my face and skin so much for the better, less acne less oil and dryness.

Why only 3 stars? Because it stinks. I don't mean mildly. This stuff smells awful. I didn't have great expectations of this product, but it seems to be doing a good job of gentle exfoliation. My face feels smooth after use. But surely something can be done about the awful smell. It smells like something rotten or decaying. If you can get around the odor, this is a good product. Let's just say I'm challenged with each use to see how long I can hold my breath to avoid the stench.
Great, exfoliating face wash. I used to buy the Target brand at Target but they quit selling it. This was a good replacement. Though, it could smell better.

Excellent product at an amazing price! I had been using a popular scrub that begins with IL and is quite pricey…save your cash and use this one!!! Smell is not strong and I think it is quite pleasant!
I love the feeling when applying it on my skin it makes it soft and I have very dry sensitive skin. I really like it and great deal for the price .
Great smell works well on my sensitive skin . There wasn’t any irritation, left my skin feeling smooth and soft.

The scrub is amazing and it does the job. Some scrubs that claim to exfoliate don’t actually exfoliate, but this one does amazingly. It’s got the granules and the right texture and my skin was smooth afterwards. The only downside is the smell of the product. I thought it’d smell like apricot because of the name and the one apricot ingredient in its composition list, but instead, this product has a very strong, artificial, unpleasant smell. It’s not that bad that I’d not use the product, but keep that in mind if you’re sensitive to strong scents.

Used by myself my 13 year old and 23 year old. Good thickness and you can feel it exfoliate and the little granules rubbing dead shaking from your face . Leaves skin feeling soft and works on my elbows and heels of my old feet also lol , good value. Will buy again.

I’ll start with it’s not the only scrub that I use, but it’s one of my favorites. It’s gentle, it doesn’t have an overbearing smell, although the smell is different than any apricot scrub that I’ve used. I recommend giving it a try. It’s not like it’s gonna break the bank.

I have used Walnut shell and Apricot shell face scrubs in the past to soften whiskers for pre-shave with great success, but unfortunately they are harder to find as dermatologists have deemed them too abrasive. Like many "scrubs" on the market today, this is simply a moisturizer with miniscule micro-grains. The scent, too, is unremarkable. Of the 3 Features I was given to rate: 5-stars for Sensitive Skin and Moisturizing properties; 2-stars for Scent. There was no option to rate Exfoliation Effectiveness, which tells you exactly what to expect from this product.

I've used this scrub for years now and I'm 39. It always makes my face feel soooo soft and smooth afterwards and does not dry my skin out, even when I use it daily. I think it has contributed to a smoother appearance.
Works just like St Ives. It’s great at clearing dead skin/exfoliating. Will buy again.

avis.titre: Second time purchasing, but it exploded.
avis.texte: Love how this product works on my face. It feels nice and smooth and the smell is not too strong. It leaves a tingling feeling on my face which makes me feel like that it's doing the job. Only reason why I gave it a one star is because mines was all over the packaging, which was damaged to the point that bacteria could have gotten inside. It could have been used on my face. What a waste.
Skin feels a little dry and a bit itchy until the water dries out from the skin

This product is exactly what I wanted. I can’t seem to keep a face scrubber for very long so I got this apricot scrub and it gets the job done. My face looked and felt clean after one use. Highly recommend :3

I am always happy to save a couple dollars buying store brand products IF they're comparable. I did a head to head comparison of St. Ives, Healthy Accents, Equate and Amazon Basics facial scrubs and I found Amazon's version to have fewer and larger grit than the other 3 products. For me, I want my facial scrub to have lots of fine grit to micro polish my skin. In that regard it was the worst option. St. Ives the best, pretty close between Equate and Healthy Accents and a distant last for Amazon.

avis.titre: Better than Mountain Falls/ I see neither Salicylic acid nor Benzoyl Peroxide as an ingredient
avis.texte: I had been using St. Ives for a time when Amazon suggested I try Mountain Falls as it being similar. What I found was I preferred St. Ives, it has salicylic acid, and it scrubbed a little rougher to do more work and help with some itchiness if used on my back. The second picture are the ingredients of Solimo and Mountain falls. They are identical and in exactly the same order. What I have found is Solimo is a bit rougher per individual shell components which I makes me prefer it to Mountain Falls and at a lower price point. It is also at a lower price point than St. Ives, but, I prefer the latter due to the quality and type of ingredients. Pictured above from top down I've included Top (Solimo) Middle (Mountain Falls) and bottom (St. Ives).

avis.titre: Does a good job of cleaning
avis.texte: This apricot scrub feels surprisingly and oddly good! It is less harsh than regular soap. I can feel the bits and pieces of hard pieces in it that helps scrubs and cleans my skin. Be careful rubbing this near your eyes. You do not want this on your eyes. I only need to squeeze out a tablespoon of it and gently rub it around my face. It smells somewhat like an apricot but is not exactly the same. It's also not quiet completely artificially scented. After washing it off, it does not leave a strong after-scent, which I am grateful. Compared to regular soap, my skin feels smooth after using this cleanser.

avis.titre: 🌱great product at a great price, dont love fragrance🌱
avis.texte: ..its not terrible but i don't love it.. But it wouldnt stop me from using it.. This reminds me of the one my mom had growing up.. Nothings quite as " scrubby " as all those little crushed apricots! Can't beat the price.. 🐈🐈🐈🐈

avis.titre: Works well, but I dont love the smell
avis.texte: Maybe I’m not a big fan of apricots. It does a really good job of cleaning, but its right by your nose!

Solimo Apricot Facial cleanser is great for exfoliating the skin.I started using this product everyday and it not harsh on my skin and it leaves my skin feeling fresh and smooth without dead or dry skin without over exfoliating. Packet comes with 3 pack of 6 ounce facial cleanser

avis.titre: Great scrub for skin care rotation
avis.texte: This scrub is very rich with beads and very creamy. Scent is light, barely noticeable, not overpowering at all. This scrub removed all of my make up residue and I really scrubbed my nose since it’s my bad area with oils built up. I’m very happy with the result I received. Skin soft & silky, oils on my nose completely gone, skin was prepped for night time routine. I’m going to use it every other night rotating this scrub and regular cleanser. Very nice results, skin smooth. I liked it!

avis.titre: I Like It Better Than The Name Brand Face Scrub! 😃
avis.texte: An order is 3, 6 ounce tubes. This Apricot Scrub has a light fruity scent, it's really nice & refreshing. It's light tan in color with bits of darker pieces. I found the texture nice. It's creamy with a little grit. I liked that the actual "scrub" part, the granules were small like sand. Very fine. I've tried name brand facial scrubs & didn't like that the "scrub granules" were quite large & therefore very irritating to my sensitive skin. Often times they felt like glass scraping against my skin. With this scrub I had no skin irritation or side effects. My skin felt smoother after I used it.

avis.titre: Works very  well ,but not a fan of the fragrance ~
avis.texte: This brand as compared to others works just the same. It doesn’t bother my sensitive skin at all. You save a lot by buying this brand over the name brands. The only difference is the fragrance . That’s what I don’t like about it at all. It smells like the plastic tube it’s in more than apricot. Update: after using it several times a week the plastic smell from the tube has subsided. Maybe it was like that due to being hot in the mailbox. It still isn’t very fragrant- but then too much fragrance may irritate anyway.

I’m in love with this face wash. It’s so luxe- extremely thick and creamy and it’s packed full of natural walnut shells for exfoliation. My face feels and looks like a million bucks after using it. I’ve discovered that apricot does amazing things to my skin and I just feel like this face wash is a total score.

Normally I write really good reviews however this is something that I want to warn other ladies about I have used this apricot scrub two times the first time I didn't notice my fingers turning yellow because I went straight to bed. Well I woke up this morning and I scrubbed my face with the apricot scrub and I rinse my face. I came into the kitchen and started getting my children school bags ready and I noticed my fingers were differently colored the normal LOL. And I smelled them and it smelt like the apricot scrub so I know it's the apricot scrub it's not because one of my kids is backpacks had something weird on it you know how kids are LOL so in my book The apricot scrub does not smell good at all I basically had to hold my breath to get through the scrubbing process and also it leaves a stain on your fingers. Needless to say I will not be buying this product again which sucks because I was really excited about it but you know how that goes sometimes the cheaper the product the cheaper the materials and I know that so my bad.
The scent is very soft. Perfect to sensitive skins. Cleans and left smooth your face. The shipping was fast.

Amazon brand has never let me down until now. Bad reaction to my face/skin, the scent alone smelled like cheap candles and the film left behind was undeniable. My skin over produced oil to the point of stained my pillow case 😳😔 And I have never had any face care product create such an EXTREME reaction!

avis.titre: The tube is not sealed, when pressed scrub comes form back and makes a mess.
avis.texte: Manufacturing defect. And amazon.con says this product is not eligible for return.

avis.titre: This is a waste of money
avis.texte: Please, please do not buy. This touch like sand. And smell like S***.
